MissionSettings.Blurb: The Hyper-Pulse Generator is located in the eastern sector, at Nav Point Three. It lies on the top of a high ridge, with a few low, cratered areas surrounding. There appears to be one main ramp leading up to the entrance of the HPG base, guarded by Gauss Turrets and a mixed company of 'Mechs and vehicles. The other objectives are the 2 Weapons Facilities, located at Nav One and Two. Capture them. And don't worry, you'll get bonus pay for the problems caused by destroying an HPG - your wallet is covered. One extra note, because Carver's moon has no atmosphere, Support cannot be flown in for you.
